disclaimer: Decision-support rules only. Not legal advice. Each rule must be confirmed against its source before the app uses it.

rules.text: The waiting period for pre-existing diseases can be at most 36 months (3 years).
rules.source_name: IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business
rules.source_ref: Dated 29 May 2024, effective 1 April 2024. Confirm section number for pre-existing disease waiting period.

rules.text: After 60 months (5 years) of continuous coverage, the insurer cannot reject a claim for non-disclosure or misrepresentation. Exception: proven fraud. Applies to policies issued or renewed on or after 1 April 2024.
rules.source_name: IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business
rules.source_ref: Dated 29 May 2024, effective 1 April 2024. Confirm section number for moratorium period.

rules.text: Exclusions clearly written in the policy as permanent exclusions can be valid grounds for rejection.
rules.source_name: Policy wording (applies to each policy individually)
rules.source_ref: Checked against the uploaded policy, not an external rule. Verify the policy's exclusion clause itself.

rules.text: Before approaching the Insurance Ombudsman, the policyholder must first make a written complaint to the insurer. The Ombudsman can be approached if the insurer rejects the complaint, does not reply within 30 days, or the policyholder is not satisfied.
rules.source_ref: Rule 14. Confirm sub-clause against the official text at cioins.co.in.

rules.text: An Ombudsman complaint must be filed within 1 year of the insurer's rejection of the complaint. Claim value limit is up to Rs 50 lakh. Awards must be complied with within 30 days.
rules.source_ref: Confirm rule number and the Rs 50 lakh limit against the official text at cioins.co.in.
